nodes.question: How are environmental permitting and emissions activities regulated in the UK?
nodes.answer: In the UK, environmental permitting is regulated by Regulations 2016 SI 2016/11542 (EPR), applicable to England and Wales, which regulates emission activities, installations, and mobile plants, as well as waste operations and materials facilities.
